exercise.name: Alternating Dumbbell Curl
library_steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms forward.
Curl one dumbbell to your shoulder while the other arm stays still.
Lower it slowly and repeat with the other arm; both arms make one rep.
exercise.one_line_summary: Standing, a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward. Picture 1: left arm curled to ~124 deg while the right hangs still; picture 2: the reverse. Upper arms stay by the sides, trunk still.

setup.target: Feet hip-width, knees soft, trunk upright and still.
setup.why: S1 watched trunk and knees to stop cheating.

setup.target: Palms forward (supinated); S1 notes the forearm may start half-turned and is fully palm-up by ~90 deg of bend.

movement.joint: working elbow (left in picture 1, right in picture 2)

muscles.emg: Measured in this exact exercise at 65 % 1RM (S1); same activity across hand positions (S2)
muscles.role: Bends the elbow; what the exercise is for.

muscles.emg: Active; lower in the dumbbell curl than in bar curls (S1)
muscles.surface: Thumb side of the upper forearm.

muscles.role: Holds the upper arm by the side.

mistakes.mistake: Swinging the body to start the curl
mistakes.what_it_looks_like: Trunk leans back as the arm rises.
mistakes.why_it_matters: Momentum lifts the weight; S1 policed trunk and knee motion.

mistakes.what_it_looks_like: Upper arm swings forward at the top.
mistakes.why_it_matters: ACE keeps the elbows close to the sides.

sources.citation: Marcolin G, et al. 2018. Differences in electromyographic activity of biceps brachii and brachioradialis while performing three variants of curl. PeerJ 6:e5165.
sources.what_it_gave: Standing alternating dumbbell curl at 65 % 1RM, 10 reps, 3 s per rep, range 123 +- 12 deg; forearm palm-up by ~90 deg; EZ bar > dumbbell for brachioradialis.

sources.citation: Kleiber T, et al. 2015. Front Physiol 6:215, doi 10.3389/fphys.2015.00215 (EMG of biceps brachii and brachioradialis in elbow flexion by hand position).
sources.what_it_gave: Biceps unchanged across hand positions; brachioradialis share higher only when pronated.

sources.citation: American Council on Exercise. Exercise Library: Standing Bicep Curl.
sources.what_it_gave: Palms up, elbows close to the sides, hands to the shoulders, lower slowly.

Hanging dumbbell clear of the thigh
